messages:
tina_finance: Alert: noticed $15.4k GPU surge on project shared-research in April, invoice line shows unlabeled VMs. attaching quick BI extract.

omar_sre: saw autoscaler jump for nodepool 'research-gpu-pool' overnight for ~6h. likely a cron-triggered burst.

nina_research: we ran a distributed sim that should tag pods with 'research-sim' but our k8s->vm label exporter sometimes drops labels on new nodes. i'll check job IDs.

tina_finance: need instance IDs + timestamps to reallocate costs and file an inquiry. If any of the work is customer-facing we may need to bill the customer instead.

omar_sre: running mapping now. command used: kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.metadata.labels} {.metadata.creationTimestamp}
{end}' | grep research  then gcloud compute instances list --filter="name:(research-gpu-*)" --format=csv(name,zone,id,creationTimestamp)

chargeback-bot: Recommended steps: (1) Ops provide instance id/time windows; (2) Finance files billing inquiry with invoice and CSV; (3) Request GCP post-facto label propagation/credit; (4) Backfill internal chargeback pipeline to prefer VM metadata.

nina_research: two heavy jobs correspond to AcmeCorp runs (customer_id: ACME-42). if GCP won't issue a credit, we may need to issue a partner rebate. i'll mark those run IDs.

tina_finance: filed ticket RC-2026-0412-22 and attached current query output. finance requests CSV by EOD so we can update April ledger. Also enabling budget alert at 60% for shared-research and monitor for unlabeled GPU spend > $300/day.

omar_sre: exported node->instance CSV and uploaded to ticket. PR open to fix instance template to include cost_owner metadata; will schedule rolling replacement tonight 23:00 UTC.

nina_research: adding namespace quota for large sims to prevent runaway scale.

tina_finance: assigning follow-ups: @omar_sre backfill CSV, @nina_research Acme reconciliation, @tina_finance follow-up on invoice credit. will track in weekly finance->ops sync. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
